blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Emerson Jones – Hong Kong Open Round of 32 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala plays Australian lucky loser Emerson Jones instead to begin her Hong Kong Open campaign on Tuesday night. Jones was a last-minute replacement for American Alycia Parks, who pulled out due to a shoulder injury. Eala, who climbed to a career-high World No. 17 on Monday, and Jones had never played each other before. Eala is seeded second in the WTA 250 hard court event. The 18-year-old Jones was swept by Russian Alexandra Shubladze, 4-6, 2-6, in the final round of qualifiers on Sunday. Jones is […]...
